changes.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now detects and recovers hung training jobs on Slurm clusters
changes.detail: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports hung job detection for Slurm-orchestrated clusters, which finds training jobs that have stopped making progress and returns them to the job queue. SageMaker HyperPod helps you provision resilient clusters for training and deploying AI/ML models. Previously, a job that hung on an NCCL timeout, a stalled data pipeline, or a deadlock kept its GPUs while Slurm reported it as running, until you noticed that the job is not making progress. Now, if a training run hangs, HyperPod detects it within minutes from the job's output and GPU activity, or from log patter
